final: WITH eligible AS (SELECT DISTINCT L.ID FROM Laboratory AS L JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND L."U-PRO" <> '-'), per_patient AS (SELECT P.ID, COALESCE(P.SEX, '') AS SEX, AVG(L.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(1.0 * L.ALP / L.GPT) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM eligible AS E JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = E.ID JOIN Laboratory AS L ON L.ID = P.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_patient_pt, AVG(avg_alp_gpt_ratio) AS avg_patient_alp_gpt_ratio FROM per_patient GROUP BY SEX
